sources.entry: 19. Lobe - Build, train, and ship custom machine learning models using an easy visual interface.

summary.name: Lobe
summary.one_liner: Lobe was a visual tool for building, training, and shipping custom machine learning models, but its desktop application is no longer under development.
use_cases: building custom image models without code
training a machine learning model visually
starting an iOS app with a custom ML model
starting a web app with a custom ML model
machine learning projects with Adafruit hardware
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitHub organization page for Lobe, which describes its tools as a way to build, train, and ship custom machine learning models through a visual interface, as listed in the directory. It notes that the Lobe desktop application is no longer under development. The public repositories include iOS-bootstrap and web-bootstrap starter projects for using a Lobe model in apps, image-tools for creating image-based datasets, and lobe-adafruit-kit, a machine learning kit made with Adafruit. The organization also has a forked docusaurus repository. The page lists 1.3k followers and a San Francisco location.
notable: Visual interface for building custom ML models without writing code (per directory listing)
Starter projects for iOS and web apps that use a Lobe model
Desktop app no longer under development
caveats: The Lobe desktop application is no longer under development
Page is a GitHub organization page, not a product landing page, so pricing and full feature details are not given
